title: DNA: Unlocking Depth Scaling in CTR Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.25659v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long user behavior sequences are among the strongest signals for click-through rate (CTR) prediction. Cross-attention makes these sequences practical for industrial ranking by keeping compute linear in sequence length. Yet the gains from stacking cross-attention layers taper off: on Taobao search, growing a cross-attention stack from 16 to 28 layers adds only 0.02 percentage points (pt) of AUC. We argue that the key-value side is the bottleneck. Each layer projects the same behavior sequence into keys and values, so adding depth gives the model more reads of a fixed sequence. We propose DNA (Dual-stream Nexus Attention), which lets the sequence itself evolve with depth. At each layer, the request representation (the search query, user features and scene) first reads the sequence. translated_title: DNA：解锁CTR模型中的深度扩展
translated_abstract: 长用户行为序列是点击率（CTR）预测中最强的信号之一。交叉注意力使这些序列在工业排序系统中变得实用，因为其计算量随序列长度呈线性增长。然而，堆叠交叉注意力层带来的收益逐渐递减：在淘宝搜索场景中，将交叉注意力堆叠层从16层增加到28层，仅带来0.02个百分点（pt）的AUC提升。我们认为键值侧是瓶颈所在。每一层都将相同的行为序列投影为键和值，因此增加深度只是让模型对固定序列进行更多次读取。我们提出DNA（Dual-stream Nexus Attention，双流枢纽注意力），使序列本身随深度演化。在每一层中，请求表示（搜索查询、用户特征和场景）首先读取序列；随后每个行为token关注更新后的请求表示，并利用其读取到的内容更新自身，从而使下一层读取到一个由……塑造的序列（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出DNA（双流枢纽注意力）方法，通过让用户行为序列随模型深度逐层演化更新，而非每层重复投影同一固定序列，突破了CTR模型中交叉注意力堆叠的深度扩展瓶颈。
en_tdlr: Proposes DNA (Dual-stream Nexus Attention), which lets the user behavior sequence itself evolve with depth instead of repeatedly projecting the same fixed sequence at each layer, unlocking depth scaling in CTR models beyond the diminishing gains of stacked cross-attention.
